title.zh: 会读引号的 CSV 一行
title.en: A CSV line that understands quotes

intro.zh: parseCsvLine 把一行 CSV 拆成字段，现在只会按逗号切。引号里的逗号本该是内容，不是分隔符。
intro.en: parseCsvLine splits one CSV line into fields, and today it only splits on commas. A comma inside quotes is content, not a separator.

zh: 双引号里的逗号属于字段内容。
字段两边的双引号不出现在结果里。
引号里的两个双引号代表一个双引号。
空字段是空字符串，末尾的空字段也要留着。
en: A comma inside double quotes belongs to the field.
The quotes around a field are not part of the result.
Two double quotes inside a quoted field mean one double quote.
An empty field is an empty string, including a trailing one.

hint.zh: 一个字符一个字符地走，记住此刻是否在引号里：在引号里时逗号只是普通字符，遇到引号先看下一个字符是不是也是引号。
hint.en: Walk the line one character at a time and remember whether you are inside quotes: inside, a comma is just a character, and on a quote look at the next character to see whether it is a quote too.
